intro: The Chime is your answer to simplicity. Its grooved headboard adds a unique visual appeal, & its hydraulic storage keeps essentials at hand – creating a clutter-free space that feels effortlessless​.

features.title: Vertical grooved minimalistic headboard design
features.text: Sometimes, less really is more. The minimalist headboard with vertical grooves blends modern style with simplicity, giving your space a clean, timeless look.

features.title: Half hydraulic box storage for easy access
features.text: The half hydraulic lift-up mechanism makes accessing under-bed storage effortless and keeps your seasonal wear neatly stowed away, giving you a clutter-free room without the heavy lifting.

features.title: Prelaminated particle board for everyday use
features.text: Constructed from prelaminated particle board, ensuring durability and resistance to wear.

features.title: Sonoma oak finish for a natural look
features.text: Finished in Sonoma oak, adding a touch of natural elegance to the bedroom.

features.title: Knockdown design for easy assembly
features.text: Accommodates thick mattresses to enhance your sleep quality—because a good night’s rest is essential.

name: Chime King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Half Hydraulic Storage
